title: cloud:* plan-status widget so the cloud pricing page can mark the organization's current plan
body:
## Source

cloud#2434 item 5: the pricing page does not mark the current plan. The 免费版 card shows 「开始使用」 to an org already on Free. The cloud#2434 dev found this in PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2451 on 2026-09-28. Epic objectstack-ai/cloud#2440.

## Why cloud cannot do it alone

The pricing page is static metadata. `PageVariableSchema` has no data source, and the page expression scope (`current_user`, `features`, `page.*`) carries no organization plan. The plan is only available from `GET /cloud/environment-entitlements` (`plan`), and only objectui widgets read that.

## Direction

The dev's recommendation, which the epic PM accepts: an objectui `cloud:*` plan-status widget that reads that plan, following the same pattern as `cloud:onboarding-next`. cloud then places it on the pricing page.

## Acceptance

1. The widget renders the organization's current plan.
2. cloud can mark the current plan card on the pricing page. That is a follow-up on objectstack-ai/cloud#2434 item 5.
